parts.name: Cabinet Frame
parts.Basic_description: The cabinet frame is the main structural body of the cabinet, made of plywood, providing rigidity and shape.
parts.Functional_description: It supports all other parts including the base, shelves, door, and drawer, ensuring stability and load-bearing capacity.
parts.Movement_description: It is a fixed part and does not move during normal use.

parts.name: Cabinet Base
parts.Basic_description: The cabinet base is the bottom platform of the cabinet, made of plywood, providing foundational support.
parts.Functional_description: It distributes the weight of the cabinet and its contents evenly to the floor, ensuring stability.
parts.Movement_description: It is a stationary part and does not move during use.

parts.name: Shelf
parts.Basic_description: The shelf is a flat horizontal board inside the cabinet, made of plywood, used for organizing stored items.
parts.Functional_description: It provides internal storage surfaces for placing objects within the cabinet.
parts.Movement_description: It may be removable or adjustable but typically remains stationary during use.

parts.name: Cabinet Door
parts.Basic_description: The cabinet door is a hinged front panel made of MDF, used to cover and access the storage space.
parts.Functional_description: It allows access to the interior of the cabinet and protects stored items from dust and view.
parts.Movement_description: It rotates about its hinges to open and close.

parts.name: Drawer
parts.Basic_description: The drawer is a sliding compartment made of plywood, located at the top of the cabinet.
parts.Functional_description: It provides accessible storage for smaller items and is frequently used for quick access.
parts.Movement_description: It slides in and out along rails or runners for operation.
